title: Slipped Away
original_lyrics:
[intro]
You're soul with no religion; there's ice in your embrace. In your dance of indecision, I see the
anger in your face. little drink to help my vision. little something for the pain. There's no drug
for my condition, there's no sweetness in the taste.
Tell me where the ride's gonna lead you. Do I have to pay to be your friend? There's nothing left to
say, when you slipped away.
I can see you fading fast. I won't let you take me. When you slipped away. I can see your burning
stare. Nothing's gonna shake me, as you slip away.
You're world of blind ambition, staring through the looking glass. You willmeet your own collision,
when your conscience comes to ask.
Steal the love from those around you, help yourself to everything. Take the shelter that surrounds
you... it leaves you standing in the rain.
Tell me if the money can heal you. Do I have to pray to make it end? There's nothing left to say when
you slipped away.
I can see you fading fast. I won't let you take me. When you slipped away... I can see your burning
stare. Nothing's gonna shake me.
Solo Section
